title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Preorders
body: Anyone had any luck finding a good deal on a physical copy of the upcoming fire emblem fortunes weave? Both the regular spots of target/bigw with their $10 coupons are unavailable as they're out of stock and don't know when they'll restock. I've tried price matching jb/officeworks with no luck (both require stock). Also forgot, switch 2 prices increase tomorrow by $70 lol. Guess whoever is desperate can do a last minute purchase?
